text.p: Two goals in five minutes from the left foot of Ian Woan enabled Nottingham Forest to come from behind and beat Newcastle 2-1 in the fourth round of the English Football Association (F.A.) Cup on Sunday.
After a tense first half stalemate at St. James' Park, England striker Les Ferdinand headed home a John Beresford cross in the 60th minute to the delight of the home fans.

Forest, currently battling to climb out of the premier league relegation zone, fought back and equalised in the 76th minute when a long range shot by Woan, who had failed to score previously this season, was deflected past Newcastle keeper Shaka Hislop by Beresford.
Four minutes later Beresford miskicked a clearance and Woan pounced to hammer the ball into the top corner from 25 metres.
It was Forest's fifth successive victory under manager Stuart Pearce but a disappointment for Newcastle counterpart Kenny Dalglish.
